submission.justification: After comprehensive simulation analysis across all three candidate mixtures at gas gaps of 1.0, 2.0, and 3.0 mm, Mixture-G3 at 2.0 mm gap delivers the best possible time resolution of 0.908 ns. This configuration directly fulfills the primary goal of achieving the best possible time resolution. The 2.0 mm gap is optimal for all mixtures, with both smaller and larger gaps degrading performance. G3 demonstrates substantial performance advantages: 42% better than G2 (1.290 ns) and 114% better than G1 (1.941 ns) at their optimal gaps. While G1 and G2 offer environmental benefits through reduced fluorinated gas content, the task explicitly prioritizes time resolution as the primary goal, and no hard environmental policy constraint excludes G3 from consideration. All technical requirements are met: G3 is from the candidate list, the 2.0 mm gap falls within the 1-3 mm range, the mixture is compatible with the HV system (up to 12 kV), and 90% gas recirculation is available for environmental mitigation.
